translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nzrmcngr Mz Jiszs

Mzli kc Herot Kc Tqmyalz tqngini-ngrde king r Judiz Provins, King kxetu ngr lr Rom kc tqmnc kz, drtqde Agzstzs. X Herot mnclzbz bade. King Agzstzs atwzlrpx-ngrde natqde kx leplz amrlx kcng tqaclvele, drtqdr nayro mz nzxpe-lxblr-krdr takes.
Krlc nzryrongr drtq kx ayrnrngr kx krlzbzle lr Jiu mz natq kx kapx King r Rom. Mzli lcde kzdq ncblo drtqde Kwaerinizs aclvele Provins kc etu Siriz. X Herot kc tqaclvele lr Jiu mnclz-kzpz bade.
Zbz lr Jiu amrlx sc tzyrkrpe-kzng. Ncblo esz' kc vzkipele mz taon nyz melrmqde, mz nzryrongr drtqde.

Zbz Josip mz Mxri kc tzrkalzpemqng mztea Naszret mrkc Gzlili Provins, x sc tzvzpeng mztea Betleem mrkc Judiz Provins. Krlc mztea nyz King Devet mzli kc bqnc. Josip vzkile Betleem murde vzpxm mz neidu lr Devet.
Josip nzvzng ncdr Mxri kc tqyr, murde nzpipe kx nayrlzng ncdr x drtqdr nayc lxblr mz nzryrongr.
Mzli kc tzmnc-ngrdr Betleem, sc tqkrlzpebzle mzli kx Mxri narmc-ngrde mz doa kxtopwz.
Nzmwipxmqng mz ma nyz kzu, murde trpnzngr ma kx namnc-ngrdr. Mikatxde mrlxde kx ayrnrngr, x otibzle bulvztile lrpz. Sc tqayrbqlzpemle mz da kx nzmutio kzu.
Kzdung Enjrl Nzadcpx-lzbqbzng Mz Kxnzaclveng Sip Nedrng
Mz nrlckxbq lcde kzdung ncblo nzaclvelr sip nedrng mz nardzng, me esotrpz Betleem.
Kzdq enjrl ne Yawe adcpx-lzbqbz badr, zbz zyzlr kxetu kxluli rpnaobz badr, o-ngaletxde nidr. Ncblo kcng nzmwxlrszbqtx-pnzng.
A' rpibz enjrl kc badr kx, “Bzkq mwxlramu. Murde rtwzmc bamu nrpa kxmrlz. Nrpa lc narkabz nzabrtzngr kxetu mz leplz amrlx.
Mz nrlckxbq ka, mrkc mz taon nyz Devet, Mevalu nzmika, Kxnzmcpx kc tqngi Kxetu Lod!
Kxnamu nzglx-krmu doa lc nide sele. Namcamu dq itoto nzbulvzti lrpz, x yrbqlzm mz da kx nzmutio kzu.”
Nzpwrkilvc-ngrdr dzbe enjrl kxetu kx ngi ami kx vzom Heven, nzadcpx-lzbqpe-kzpzng. X enjrl lcng amrlx nzangrlvzlr Gct.
Nzrpilr kx, “Takitrde nzamatqngr Gct kc tqmnc Heven kc tqyctxlz. X mz nrlc, nzmnc-zpwxngr sa naycbz mz leplz kcng tqabrtzlvzleng!”
Zbz Enjrl kcng sc tzrlaszpelr nidr, tzyzlulzpe-moung Heven. Zbz ncblo kcng sc tzrpi-etrpelr kx, “Navzpeku ena Betleem mz nzmc-krgu da kc tqprtz, tqpipem Yawe bagu, mz natqde kc tqtwzm enjrl bagu.”
Zbz sc tzngrlrpeng Betleem, tzmcpelr Mxri, Josip, x itoto kc nzyrbqlz-krmle mz da kx mutio kzu, da kc tqwai nzpi-krbz enjrl le.
Kx nzmcpelr itoto kc, sc tzpipebzlr mz Josip x Mxri nike enjrl kc pi-ngrde itoto kc.
X leplz kcng amrlx tzxlrlr nrpa lc tzkctitxpxlr da lcng.
X Mxri yrlq-amqngile da lcng mz nabzde, sc tqaoti-zvzpe drtwrde.
Zbz ncblo kcng sc tzyzlupe-mopwzng mz sip nedrng, tzangrlvzlr Gct mz da kc tzxlrlr x tzmcpelr, da kc tqwai nzpi-krbz enjrl kc le badr.
Nzyrlqbzlr Drtq Jiszs

Mzli kc itoto kc zbq rde tqrtqmzpe-ngrde, sc tqkrlzpebzle mzli kx napakrpe-ngrde mz nzvz-nqblq-krde Lou sc Mosis. Murde nzrpakrngr ngi rkx kx nide doa ne Gct. X sc tzyrlqpebzlr drtqde Jiszs. Drtq lc pi-pnzbz enjrl kc mz Mxri mzli kc itoto trabzoka-ngrde mz nelzde.
Simion X Ana Mz Mangr-nzangiongr

Zbq nzpnu-pwx (40) otx mz nibr nzrmcngr mz Jiszs, sc tqkrlzpebzle mzli kx Mxri navz-ngrde mz Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe mrkc Jerusalem, mz nzalqngi-moungr mz nzvz-nqblq-krde Lou kxtr. X sc tzvzmipe-kzlr doa kc topwz mz nzrlrpx-krbzlrle mz mq Yawe, x nakrka'lvz kx natr x nawztrpz mz Gct kalr.
Murde navz-nqblqlr Loukxtr mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Doa kx ngi doa ncblo kx ayrnrngr amrlx, narlrpx-ngrbz mz mq Yawe.”
Mxri x Josip nzvz-kz-ngrdr mz nzka-krdr blz ngr nzalqngingr mz nzvz-nqblq-krde Loukxtr, mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Nakabz mz pris nran nali, a' kx trpnzngr le e bona nali, nanibqbz mz Yawe.”

Mzli lcde kzdq kc ncblo mncne mrkc Jerusalem, drtqde Simion, kc tqtubq-esz'ngr mz nzobqkr Gct. Amatqle Gct mz da amrlx. X sc tqaenzlile nzvz-krm Kxnzmcpx mz nzarlapx-krde lr Israel. X Mqngrkxtr kc tqmncpxm bade,
pibzle bade kx namc-kaile Kxnzmcpx ne Yawe, x sc tqbz ate.
Kzdq zbq Simion mailz Mqngrkxtr Mangr-nzangiongr. Mz zbq lcde Mxri ncdr Josip nzprmitrpzlr itoto Jiszs elr, mz nzvz-nqblq-krdr Lou sc Mosis.
X kx mc Simion itoto kc, sc tqotipebzle, tqbrlcpele. X sc tqglqpxpele Gct x tqawipebz bade.
X sc tqrpipebzle kx, “Yawe, ninge kxnzawz nem. X mzli ka takitrpede nzbz-krnge. Murde atutrpeq natqm
mz nzmctx-angidrpe-krnge mz mzke' Mevalu nem kc tqatwzlr-ngrme mz nzarlapx-krde leplz.
X aelwapx-ngrbzme nide mz mz leplz amrlx.
Murde na-apule zyzlr kc tqaelwapxbzle nqmq krm mz kxtrngiulrJiu. X nabatrpzle mz leplz nzamatq-krdr nigr lr Israel, mz nzngini-krgr doa nemqng.”
Trte Jiszs x lxede nzkctitxpxlr natq kcng tqpingr Simion Jiszs.
Zbz krka'lvztxbzng Simion nidr. X sc tqrpipebzle mz Mxri kx, “Doa lc mcpx Gct mz nzngini-krde rkx. X nigu lr Israel kxkqlu kxnzpxtxpx-ngrdr nide nataong. A' nigu kcng tzabrtzlvzlr nide narlapxng.
Da kx aoti drtwr leplz sa na-aelwapx-lzbqngr mz nzabrtzlvz-krdr nide o nzpxtxpx-krdr nide. X mz nibrde nzaetq-ngrbz drtqde sa na-apule toki kx luplxtrpzle nabzm.”
X kzdq kc blang, mncne kz mzli lcde. Drtqde Ana kc tqngi profet. Nide inyx Fanwel, vzpxm mz nqvi lr Asz.
Ana yrlz pnz mzli kc tqnginibe-ngrde olvi, x nzmnctilr mz ncblo ngrde yiz rlimz x ncblo kc sc tqbzpe.
Yiz ngrde nzpnu-rtqmz-nrade-pwx (84). X olvz lc vz zvz mz Mangr-nzangiongr. X mzli kang kqlu, nzangio-krde Gct vzmi nzaxtx-krbzle dakxnzng mz nzkrka'-krde.

X mz nabznepi lcdepwz tqmncngr Simion badr Josip x Mxri, Ana kc tqkaputrpe-kzpz mrkc tzmnc-ngrdr. Kx xlrpele natq Simion, sc tqawipebz mz Gct mz nzatwzlr-krmle Kxnzmcpx nede. X sc tqycmnetrpe-ngrde doa kc topwz, murde naxlrbz leplz kcng tzobqtipxlr Gct nzarlapx-krde lr Jerusalem, x lr Israel amrlx. X tresakiu nzpi-krbzlele mz leplz kxkqlu.
Mz nibr nzyrkrpx-krbz nzalengr da lcng amrlx tzyr mz Loukxtr, sc tzyzlupe-moung Naszret, mrkc Gzlili Provins.
X doa kc yrlvzlzm x xplr. X nzyrplapx-krde etu-esz'ngr murde Gct okatr-zvzle nide.
Jiszs Mncpxm Mz Mangr-nzangiongr
Mz yiz kang kqlu trte Jiszs badr lxede nzvz-zvzng Jerusalem, mz nzprtrngr mz nzmungr kc tqetu tzrpibz Nzamyangr.
Mzli kc Jiszs tqkrlzpe-ngrbzle yiz kx nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12), sc tzvzmipe-kzlr mz nzmungr kc mrkc Jerusalem, mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nqmq krdr.
Zbq ngr nzmungr kcng kx yrkrpxpebzle, sc tzrkalzpemqng mz nzyzlungr mrnyzdr Naszret. A' trtede x lxede trnzkrlzlru kx Jiszs mnctxpe Jerusalem.
Murde nzpnzkr drtwrdr kx prtrpebz mz leplz kcng tzrtwayzpe-kaing mrnyzdr. X nzvztilr zbq kxesz'. Zbz sc tzrtangrtitrpebzlr mz mzlir kxnginidrng x leplz kx nzkrlzti-lzbqng badr.
A' mz trnzmc-krdru nide, sc tzyzlupe-moung Jerusalem, tzrtangrtipe-moulr.
Mz zbq kratq, sc tzmcpelr mz nabz Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe. Tqwxbu mz mzlir kxnzalvztrng mz Lou sc Mosis. Tqlalztqbz badr x tqveabz badr natq.
Leplz kcng tzlalztqbzng bade nzkctitxpxlr nzyrplatitrkr narde da x nzayzlu-krde natq kx nzrveati.
Nzpwrkilvcpengr trtede x lxede. Sc tqrpipebz lxede kx, “?Mrlxnge, nike tqale-ngrme da lc bagr? Nigr mz trtem, vztipe drtwrgr nim. Bztitxpegr nzrtangrtingr nim.”
Rpibzle kx, “?Memule trkrlz-ngrwamuu me namnc-ngrne? ?Trkrlzwamuu kx namncx mz ma nyz Trtenge?”
A' tryrplatitru nardr da kc tqpibzle badr.
Zbz sc tzvzpe-moung badr Naszret. Nzmnc-krdr kc Naszret lxngiti-txpwzle trtede x lxede. X lxede yrlqle mz nabzde da lcng amrlx.
X Jiszs yrlvzlzm mz nrkrdrtq. X nzyrplapx-krde etunelz, x nzabrtzlvzkr Gct nide etunepx zlwz, da kc tqwai nzabrtzlvzkr leplz nide.

footnotes.text: Asz ngi kzdq mrlx Jekop kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12).
Mz nqmq kr lr Jiu, obla naprmitr mz nzangiongr Gct mz Mangr-nzangiongr mzli kc tqkrlzbzle yiz nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li o tq (12 o 13).
